## Scope and evidence

- Existing work item and approved scope:
- Behavior changed and acceptance criteria:
- Exact revision, checks run and results (include checks not run):
- Independent review/verification:

## Release review

Apply [the maintenance handoff](https://github.com/spurwork/laravel-taxes/blob/master/docs/maintenance-handoff.md) and existing repository instructions.

- Branch/PR/provider automation and credentialed CI impact reviewed:
- Target and migration/dependency order, or evidence that none apply:
- Recovery artifact, rollback/restore evidence and responsible operator:
- Release authority and remaining approval/acceptance gaps:

A documentation-only change or draft PR does not by itself make publication or deployment safe.
